summary: The root نشأ primarily means to originate, grow, or rise up. It signifies the beginning of existence, development, or an upward movement.

provenance.lane: Edward William Lane, An Arabic-English Lexicon (1863-93), public domain. Digital text via Perseus, Tufts University, CC BY-SA 3.0 US.
provenance.summary: Editorial summary derived from the Lane entry. NOT Lane's own wording. Shown as a gloss only; the Lane text below is the source.

headwords.def: aor. نَشَاَ; and نَشُؤَ, aor. نَشُاَ; inf. n. نَشْءٌ and نُشُوْءٌ and نَشَآءٌ and نَشْأَةٌ and نَشَآءَةٌ; He lived; (K;) and (accord. to Sh) he rose, or became elevated, or high. (TA.) [ It rose. ] النَّشْأَةُ الأُخْرَى, or النَّشَآءَةُ, [Kur, liii. 48,] The resurrection: [lit., the other life ]. (TA.) النَّشْأَةُ الآخِرَةُ, or النَّشَآءَةُ, [Kur, xxix. 19, the same: lit., the latter life ]. (TA.) [See also نَشْأَةٌ below.] نَشَأَ, (S, K,) inf. n.
and are syn., (S, K,) [signifying He was reared, made to grow, or grow up, and to become a young man. ] See 4.

He (i. e. God) raised the clouds. (S, K.) انشأ عَلَمًا He set up a beacon, or sign of the way, in a desert or highway: (TA:) and so عَلَمًا He set up a beacon, or sign of the way. (A.) انشأهُ, inf. n. إِنْشَآءٌ, He (i. e. God) caused him to attain the age of manhood, or nearly that age. (TA.) See 2. انشأ and [so TA: app. نشّأ:] He (i. e. God) created; produced; originated. (S.) انشأ اللّٰهُ الخَلْقَ God originated the creation.
تنشّأ لِحَاجَتِهِ He rose and went to accomplish his affair, or business. (AA, K.) تنشّأ عَادِيًا He arose and went running to accomplish his affair. (AA.)

إِسْتَنْشَاَ see 4. يَسْتَنْشِئُ الرِّيحَ He scents the wind: said of a wolf: (ISk, S:) and استنشأ الأَخْبَارَ He sought, or searched after, news: (K, TA:) in both instances, with and without ء; (S, * L;) being derived from نَشِيتُ الرِّيحَ (S, L) and رَجُلٌ نَشْيَانُ لِلْخَبَرِ: [see also مُسْتَنْشِئَة.] (L.) إِسْتَنْشَأْتُهُ قَصِيدَةً [ I requested him to compose, or, perhaps, to recite an ode, or the like ]. (A.)

and Risen clouds: (K:) or the first that rises of them: (S, K:) or their first appearance: (ex. لِهٰ َا السَّحَابِ نَشْءٌ حَسَنٌ These clouds have a good first appearance: ) or clouds when they appear like a piece of drapery ( مُلَآءَة ) spread out. (TA.) نَشْءٌ The exhalation, or odour, of wine. (IAar.) [See 10.] See نَاشِئٌ. Also, The young ones of camels: (Kr, K:) pl. [or rather quasi-pl. n.] نَشَأٌ. (K.)
and A creation; an original production. (Aboo-'Amr Ibn-El-'Ala, S) [See also 1.] See نَشِيْئَةٌ.

The first part that is made of a tank, or cistern. (ISk, S, K.) بَادِى النّشيْئة A tank, or cistern, of which the water is dried up, and the bottom apparent. (S.) Also, نشيئة The stone that is placed in the bottom of a tank, or cistern.

A young person past the age of puberty: (TA:) or a boy or girl past the age of childhood: (S, K:) or a comely young man: (IAar:) or a youth who has attained the stature of a man: (AHeyth:) a girl, as well as a boy, is called thus; (TA;) and they also say, جَارِيَةٌ نَاشِئَةٌ. (AA.) Pl. نَشْءٌ and نَشَأٌ (S, K [or these two are rather quasi-pl. ns.,] or the ↓ former is an inf. n. used as an epithet, Aboo-Moosa,) and نَاشِئُونَ (AHeyth) and نَواشِئُ: (TA:) or the last is a pl.
[ مَنْشَأٌ The place of origination of anything, properly and tropically; its source. ]

and A beacon, or sign of the way, raised and pointed. (K.) [See the verbs.] Also, the former, An elevated hill. الجَوَارِى المسْشَآتُ [Kur, lv. 24,] The ships with elevated sails: (Mujáhid, S, K:) or, accord. to one reading,, The ships elevating their sails: (TA:) or, advancing and retiring; or coming and going: (Fr:) or, commencing their courses. (TA.)
نَاقَةٌ مُنْشِئٌ A she-camel that has conceived: (K:) of the dial. of Hudheyl. (TA.) See مُنْشَأٌ.

(K,) also without ء, (TA,) A female diviner: (K:) so called because she seeks, or searches after, news: see the verb: or from انشأ “ he originated: ” (TA:) or مُسْتَنْشِئَةُ, without tenween, is the proper name of a certain female diviner, (T,) one of the Muwelledehs ( مُوَلَّدَات ) of Kureysh, in the time of Mohammad. (TA.)

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
mentions_note: Forms Lane discusses inside another entry rather than defining as a headword. Values index into headwords[].
